role: Human documentation for scripts/: describes selected CI/quality scripts and the add_swift_file.py pbxproj helper.
toplevel: Markdown only; no executable content. Sections are recorded as doc-section units.

units.does: no behavioural claim: title 'Scripts' and one-line intro.
no behavioural claim: heading grouping the quality/CI script descriptions.

Claims select_simulator_destination.sh selects the first usable iOS Simulator destination for the Emuqu scheme; run_tests_with_coverage.sh calls it with SCHEME and PROJECT when DESTINATION is unset (run_tests_with_coverage.sh). The script has no listed units.

Claims run_tests_with_coverage.sh runs tests with coverage and evaluates the coverage gate, with env defaults SCHEME=Emuqu, PROJECT=Emuqu.xcodeproj, RESULT_BUNDLE=build/TestResults.xcresult, MIN_COVERAGE optional and only able to raise the overall floor (check_coverage.sh floor() takes the max; a missing committed floor file is an error), DESTINATION override, MAX_TEST_WORKERS=3; and that a run failing with a simulator-infrastructure marker is retried once only when every failed test failed with such a marker, any other test failure failing at once. Verified: the script sets those defaults, retries only when unexplained_failures prints nothing, and calls check_coverage.sh with or without MIN_COVERAGE.
Claims check_coverage.sh checks app line coverage from an .xcresult and fails below threshold. Code enforces three floors (overall, logic ex-Views, Views-only), not one.

Claims check_budget_monotonicity.sh fails any diff that loosens a .ci/*.txt value against the baseline (ceiling up, min_* floor down, numeric budget deleted or no longer a number), accepts whole or decimal values, lists non-numeric baseline files (scoring_constants_hash.txt) as not compared, requires a `budget-raise-ok: .ci/<file>.txt <why>` trailer for a legitimate loosening, and needs fetch-depth 0. Matches the code.

Claims check_uitest_fresh_install.sh requires every UI-test suite to launch with -UITests-FreshInstall (via the UITestLaunch harness). Script outside this chunk confirms the grep at check_uitest_fresh_install.sh; it has no listed units.
Claims check_test_skip_budget.sh counts XCTSkip/XCTSkipUnless call sites against .ci/test_skip_budget.txt and ratchets toward zero.

Claims check_localization_bundle.sh requires every String(localized:)/NSLocalizedString to name a bundle other than Bundle.main (LanguageManager.appBundle or a bundle derived from it). Matches the script: a `bundle:` argument is required and `bundle: .main` / `Bundle.main` is rejected (check_localization_bundle.sh main_bundle regex).

Says check_fixed_font_budget.sh counts `.system(size:)` calls with a numeric-literal size (with or without the `Font` prefix) across the `Emuqu/` app target against .ci/fixed_font_budget.txt, and those in the watch app against .ci/fixed_font_watch_budget.txt.

Claims check_strict_concurrency_enabled.sh proves Swift 6 mode, SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY = complete and warnings-as-errors in every configuration. Script greps SWIFT_VERSION/SWIFT_STRICT_CONCURRENCY/SWIFT_TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS counts (check_strict_concurrency_enabled.sh).

Claims check_thread_sanitizer.sh runs the unit suite under TSan, fails on any race, is its own CI job, is run by `make ci` after the static gates, and fails a run in which no test case executed. Makefile ci lists thread-sanitizer after verify-gates and release-build; ci.yml runs it when scope != gates; the script exits 1 when xcodebuild succeeds with zero passed test cases. Script has no listed units.

Claims check_xcodebuild_pinned.sh fails when an xcodebuild invocation in the Makefile, a workflow, a script or a git hook that builds, tests, archives or lists destinations lacks -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile; the flag is defined once as XCODEBUILD_PINNED in scripts/lib/xcodebuild.sh, sourced by scripts, included by the Makefile and passed literally by inline workflow steps; a variable used without its include or source fails; -version and -exportArchive are exempt. The script does all of this.
Claims remove_swift_file.py strips the four pbxproj entries for a file and deletes it from disk with --delete. remove_swift_file.py parses --delete.
Claims install-git-hooks.sh configures repository-local hooks (.githooks). Script sets `git config core.hooksPath .githooks`; no listed units.
Claims add_swift_file.py adds a new Swift file to Emuqu.xcodeproj.
Claims the script creates PBXFileReference, PBXBuildFile, PBXGroup child and PBXSourcesBuildPhase entries. Matches add_file_to_project.
Claims usage `python3 scripts/add_swift_file.py <relative_path_to_swift_file>`; main enforces exactly one argument.
Examples adding files to Collection, Models, Views; all three folders are in the explicit group map.
Lists supported folder paths. The explicit map covers them; README omits Views/MorningResults and Views/Utilities (resolved by regex fallback) and EmuquUITests (target mapped but no group id).

Claims: unique IDs avoiding collisions, file reference, build file, group assignment by folder path, and Sources build phase entry. Code matches; the Sources phase is resolved per target via target_for_path/find_sources_build_phase_id.
Claims the file need not exist (main only warns), .swift suffix is validated, and a group error means the path is not in the supported list. Matches main.

Troubleshooting: 'Could not find group for path' and 'Could not find project file' error messages exist in add_file_to_project and main. Says paths must start with Emuqu/Sources/ although EmuquTests paths are supported.
Claims the script only modifies project.pbxproj, generates unique IDs, does not delete or modify existing entries, and can be safely re-run.
